name: the bridge endpoint exists and is guarded
description: POST /identity/bridge-simple with no body and no key.
rationale: Section 6 names POST /identity/bridge-simple and shows the call with Content-Type only. The endpoint requires X-API-Key, so an unauthenticated call answers 401. That the answer is 401 and not 404 is what tells an implementer the path is right; that the section omits the header is recorded as a deviation of its own, without a vector: a sentence missing from a document is not something a runner can watch fail.
